notes.title: PATCH 1.14 RELEASE
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii. 

The following fixes have been made in Patch 1.14, which was released today: 

Fixed a bug in the OKA Surfer customization screen where the NEW display would appear again every time the game was started. 

Fixed a bug in SEGA RACING CLASSIC 2 where some inputs were not being accepted. 

Fixed a bug in the PC version where “Intel® XeSS Frame Generation” and “Intel® Xe Low Latency” could not be selected after patch 1.12. 

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your ongoing support for the Like a Dragon & Yakuza series.

notes.title: PATCH 1.13 RELEASE
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii. 

The following fixes have been made in Patch 1.13, which was released today: 

Fixed a bug that prevented the game from progressing when opening the “Inventory” menu after redeeming the “Golden Ball” from the “Sicko Snap” menu. 

(In cases where Shen has already sent you a message about the transaction, the scenario will progress even if you do not have all of the Golden Balls in your inventory. 

Fixed a bug that prevented the sub-story “The One” movie from being displayed correctly in some cases. 

Fixed an issue in 1.12 where the frame rate dropped and loading times had increased compared to previous versions. 

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your ongoing support for the Like a Dragon & Yakuza series.

notes.title: PATCH 1.12 RELEASE
notes.content:
Announcement of Patch 1.12 Release for Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii 

Thank you for playing Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii. We have released patch 1.12 today, which includes the following fixes: 

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where manual saving was not possible. 
[/list]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where loading a save data on a ship under certain conditions would cause the player to fall into the sea and be unable to return. 
[/list]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the golden ball could not be obtained. 
[/list]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where arcade game rankings were not being saved.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Corrected various typographical errors and improved localization issues. 
[/list]
[list]
[*]Various other bug fixes to improve stability and quality. 
[/list]
[list]
[*]Updated to Intel XeSS 2.0.1. 
[/list]
[list]
[*]Fixed a rare crash issue that occurred during resource loading. 
[/list]

The cause of random driver crashes on certain NVIDIA GPUs is still under investigation by the GPU vendor. It has been confirmed that setting a frame rate limit to 60 FPS reduces the likelihood of crashes. If you are experiencing frequent crashes, please try this solution. 

Go to Settings > Graphic Settings > “Set FPS to 60” 

 

Thank you for your continued support of the Like a Dragon series.

notes.title: PATCH 1.11 RELEASE & OTHER UPDATES
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii. 

We would like to inform you of the fixes included in patch 1.11 that was released today, as well as the status of our investigation of the issues that have been reported by customers. 

[h3]Patch 1.11 Fixes: [/h3]

Fixed an issue where DLSS and DLSS frame generation would not work properly in some environments. (DLSS OTA Update disabled)  

[h3]Random Crashes:[/h3] 

The development team is currently investigating the following environments in which random crashes occur on the PC version, which have been reported by multiple users. 

Windows 11 24H2  

Core i9-14900 

NVIDIA Geforce RTX 3060 GeForce Game Ready Driver 572.47/572.16/566.36 

3840x2160/120Hz VSync disabled / FPS unlimited 

In the environments above, we have confirmed that the crash will not occur by reverting the driver version to 552.44, and we are continuing to investigate this issue and other environments in consultation with the GPU vendor. 

Driver version that has been confirmed to resolve the issue: GeForce Game Ready Driver 552.44 

We are also investigating other environments and fixing more issues, and plan to release another patch soon. 

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your ongoing support for the Like a Dragon & Yakuza series.

[h3]Feb 28 Update on Verification Status:[/h3]
 
Additional driver versions confirmed that the crash will not occur in:
555.85/561.09
 
Driver versions where crashes have been confirmed
556.90/572.60
 
Currently, the latest WHQL driver confirmed to have no issues is 561.09. Since the crashes are occurring at the driver level, we are continuing to verify details with the GPU vendor.

notes.title: Roam Your Ship and Explore Downtime on Deck
notes.content:
[h1]THE GOROMARU [/h1]
Your seaworthy vessel, named after Noah's feline friend, Goro. In addition to letting you enjoy life at sea, the Goromaru boasts the captain's quarters and several other facilities, where you can kick back with some Karaoke, parties, and feasts with your crew!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/8d1bcda11e533e77949fa3d93ba332d798bfd30c.jpg[/img]

[h1]FISHING NET [/h1]
Attach a trawl net to the Goromaru so you can efficiently bring in a variety of fish, materials, and other items during your voyages!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/756ffff75e4890bfaf53e6d0dc4d80a612800268.jpg[/img]

[h1]INTERACTING WITH YOUR CREW[/h1] 
Talk to your crew members to check in with them. You can also give gifts that raise their morale and EXP, so try to mingle with them whenever possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/9607aa9c99a78ab5cc9b0e05dd2df65852c97a7f.jpg[/img]

[h1]BELOW DECK [/h1]
Below deck, you can cook in the kitchen and customize Majima's outfit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/8d6df32068e5efe1a8290fd46e2e73faf9f9f43f.jpg[/img]

[h1]PARTIES AND FEASTS [/h1]
Raise your crew's morale by throwing raucous parties! Bringing everyone together for a hearty toast will lift everyone's spirits. You can also instantly boost the EXP of a select group of crew members by inviting them to a feast in the captain's quarters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/6afa8673c0cbbdb394509093686fdbf678443506.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Scout for Crewmates & Build Your Perfect Goro Pirates Crew
notes.content:
[h1]SCOUTING [/h1]
You'll meet characters around town who may be willing to join the Goro Pirates, including some familiar faces from past games. Scout your favorites and assemble the crew of your dreams! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/54b0e697150f66ff0f8007cf800eb8c175256035.jpg[/img]

[h1]CHALLENGES [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/f15bd225e0e49e4b9f3bbd8c2a8523f1d4489d4d.jpg[/img]

Completing challenges, such as defeating enemy pirates or gathering treasure, helps Majima increase the crew's reputation. As you earn more reputation, the pirate rank of the Goro Pirates will increase, unlocking a slew of benefits! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/2befb703858a2dc5ecc6cf443c0a12b77488e2ad.jpg[/img]

[h1]A TREASURY OF TREASURES [/h1]
Use the Treasury of Treasures to discover hints about the locations of hidden treasures. 
When obtaining a treasure, you'll receive money and reputation, which can help you strengthen the Goro Pirates and improve their pirate rank. Amass a fortune and work toward completing the log! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/695416b9a5db288133a2be6d99986ba225c694d9.jpg[/img]

[h1]BOUNTIES [/h1]
Take down wanted criminals and turn them in for some cold, hard cash. Bounties are an excellent way to rake in enough dough to strengthen Majima and upgrade the Goromaru, so keep an eye out for bounties on the map and wanted posters! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/0fa32cdbdf373f75656526a900ff1c40c65501de.jpg[/img]

[h1]RINGS[/h1]
Accessories that Majima can equip with varying special effects, including boosts to his Attack and Defense. In addition to purchasing them in stores, you can acquire them by helping townspeople with their troubles or finding them in treasure chests. Your equipped rings can be seen on Majima's fingers, so have fun decking him out with different looks and effects!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/206acf90e797c05f20a5579a2384dd1f3ebcac94.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Journey Across Seas for Legendary Treasure
notes.content:
[h1]VOYAGES [/h1]
The ocean is broken up into diverse zones, each containing its own pirate crews for you to defeat. Journey across seas surrounded by luscious greenery, scorching waters riddled with volcanoes, brittle climates, and more on your hunt to track down a legendary treasure. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/47992d2f0b37b0caa17e38517b61ee0701743cf7.jpg[/img] 

Menacing bilge rats prowl the Hawaiian seas, so make sure you're fully prepared before you set sail. Use the Prepare to Sail menu to adjust your crew formation, customize the Goromaru's looks and equipment, or boost your firepower. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/cb4b274e1474ebd1438436bfd46f7bc9249754fc.jpg[/img]

[h1]SCOPE[/h1]
View objects of interest through the scope to glean more information. Assess the strength of enemy vessels, uncover details on treasure islands, and more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/057cdec049de737664f2a02a303482157be2dbc7.jpg[/img] 

[h1]THREATS AT SEA[/h1]
During voyages, the environment around you will undergo drastic changes, putting you in peril of the elements, from heavy snowfall to devastating whirlpools. Take the helm and navigate your ship to safety! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/4ab55b098b00d77752e34dbf6c9bc1500b9bee61.jpg[/img]

[h1]TREASURE ISLANDS[/h1] 
Vast riches rest on the islands surrounding Hawaii, but beware of treasure-hungry pirates, toxic gas, lava, and more! Select your finest crewmate, explore the island, and bring home the treasure! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/c2898b5282ddd55e4a6b20dd6d0baf5ba913111e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Unleash Nautical Nonsense with the Sea Dog Fighting Style
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/dfe4fa5c12ad0d58ccc231deac34584490d0fef6.jpg[/img]

A swashbuckling fighting style befitting a pirate at sea, Majima wields a pair of cutlasses and has three sidearms at his disposal. Hack and slash through swarms of enemies and draw your sidearms when the need arises!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/75142443a7e4a073e0b269d6c71746103f2ccc9c.jpg[/img]

The Sea Dog style allows Majima to quickly lay waste to his foes using his cutlasses. He can also unlock triple finishers that utilize all three of his sidearms. 

[h1]SIDEARMS [/h1]
Three unique weapons can be unlocked as you progress through the story. 
[b]Cutlass Boomerang[/b] enables Majima to throw his cutlasses and damage enemies at a distance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/3fadd129be7821e6d19c53c3f46baf707006c570.jpg[/img]
[b]
His Pistol [/b]can also be charged to deal extra damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/0d1d8211d4c34a748c282b0acf34d0459d5b5406.jpg[/img]

Lastly, he can latch on to enemies using his [b]Chain Hook[/b] and zip towards them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/cbf3d96c1ffb2cdd63e102e1aaec86558957e1e4.jpg[/img]

[h1]MADNESS GAUGE [/h1]
Using the Madness Gauge, Majima can summon dark deities capable of turning the tides of battle. Conjuring them requires treasures known as Dark Instruments, which you'll need to plunder from the ships of defeated rival pirate crews.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/8c3f9c7655a7972a2b9d0302f40034e37d873a15.jpg[/img]

[h1]DARK INSTRUMENTS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/38138a8d5b9e5342959405fb63c9482b21320692.jpg[/img]

[h1]DARK GOD OF THE WAVES [/h1]
Playing Majima's cursed violin summons man-eating sharks to the battlefield! These beasts will emerge from the ground, dealing heavy damage to enemies within range of their jaws. Furthermore, the more enemies there are, the greater the number of sharks that will appear! 

[h1]DARK GOD OF THE SKIES [/h1]
Playing a tune on Majima's cursed sax conjures an avian ally capable of conjuring up powerful winds! Enemies caught within its tornadoes will be blown into the air and suffer continuous damage. [h1]
DARK GOD OF THE EARTH [/h1]
Playing Majima's cursed guitar calls upon a ferocious ape that inflicts massive damage on enemies. The deity makes up for its limited range with its sheer destructive force. 

[h1]DARK GOD OF THE DEEP [/h1]
Blowing into Majima's cursed ocarina beckons a terrifying jellyfish to emerge from the briny deep! This creature will heal Majima and his allies, as well as shock and immobilize nearby enemies.

notes.title: Get Your Ship Together with a Closer Look at Naval Combat
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/26c97fabee93b4526561faab370dffdb954ec074.jpg[/img]

Captain the Goromaru as you explore the vast ocean! During your voyages, you'll discover lighthouses, treasure islands, and various other locations. Don’t forget to ready your cannons, as you may have to go to battle with the dangerous marauders that lurk in wait!

[h1]CANNON BATTLES [/h1]
When fighting enemies at sea, it's either sink or be sunk. Captain your ship as Majima—who can also make repairs or fire his rocket launcher at unsuspecting foes. Steer the Goromaru away from enemy fire and bombard them with cannon volleys! 

Customizing the Goromaru is also key to victory-- you can reinforce your ship's deck or swap out the cannons for flamethrowers and lasers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/463373411f62e45ee6ee15b6b7f3fc94267e94c9.jpg[/img]

[h1]DECK BATTLES[/h1]
Once you've weakened the enemy's vessel, it's time to storm their ship!

Seize the opposing ship by engaging in an all-out brawl. To claim victory, you'll need to rely on Majima's abilities and the crewmates you bring to battle. Each crewmate brings different skills to the table—some focus more on offense, while others offer more healing capabilities. With plenty of potential allies to recruit around Hawaii and Madlantis, you'll need to assemble your very own crew of misifts and raise them into legendary pirates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/2fc974c60d227fd481f9d34403b61367a666092c.jpg[/img]

[h1]THE PIRATES' COLISEUM[/h1]
The Pirates' Coliseum in Madlantis is an arena like no other. Here, you'll engage in naval battles with a variety of different rules: from one-on-one matches to chaotic free-for-alls against nine other crews! You'll also encounter a variety of colorful opponents unique to the Pirates' Coliseum, including a shady scientist, a pyromaniac, and even a sumo wrestler! All sorts of challenges await you, the Goromaru, and your trusty crew.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/b2e64d7e51535e8ca7225520d08ff46b73df253b.jpg[/img]

Get your ship together and watch this new trailer for Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii, featuring a first look at the troubles that await ye at sea with naval combat! 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P4nQLCCQnq8]WATCH THE NEW TRAILER
[/url]
Whether it rains or shines, prepare to conquer your enemies at sea and board their ship for an all-out melee! Or, test your naval prowess in the Pirates Coliseum.


[h1]PRE-ORDER NOW[/h1] 

Add Ichiban Kasuga and his pet crawfish Nancy to your pirate crew, as well as the ability to change into two of Ichiban's iconic outfits when you pre-order the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/f2a0b57709d86c7e3a83a5ee507124424dd21bdc.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061810/Like_a_Dragon_Pirate_Yakuza_in_Hawaii/

[h1]GET MORE BOOTY WITH THE DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION 
[/h1]

Upgrade to the Digital Deluxe Edition and unlock legendary crewmates, additional ship customization parts, iconic costumes, an additional karaoke song, more music to add to your in-game playlist, and more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209632/f9397293174a4aa3a51b15e4220dbb386730df79.png[/img]
